title: Cloud Load Balancing, Cloud CDN, and Cloud Armor — Request & Control Flow
purpose: Traces an external HTTPS request: from edge Anycast IP through Cloud Armor security evaluation and Cloud CDN cache check to backend Compute Engine VM.
routing_rationale: Global External ALB terminates TLS handshakes at the edge nearest the client, routing decrypted payloads across Google's high-speed fiber backbone.

nodes.label: Anycast Edge GFE (Bay Area)
nodes.detail: Terminates TCP/TLS; extracts URI path and client IP 198.51.100.24.

nodes.label: Cloud Armor Evaluator
nodes.detail: Confirms client IP is not on deny-list and request contains no SQLi signatures.

nodes.label: Cloud CDN Cache Hit
nodes.detail: Finds valid cached copy of logo.png; prepares immediate HTTP 200 payload.

nodes.label: Origin Backend VM
nodes.detail: Origin server remains untouched; zero CPU cycles spent on static asset requests.

steps.title: Edge Ingress
steps.action: Client request lands on San Francisco Anycast PoP; TLS handshakes in 8ms.
steps.why_traversal: Edge termination eliminates long cross-country TLS negotiation latency.

steps.title: Armor Validation
steps.action: Cloud Armor inspects request headers and parameters at hardware speed.
steps.why_traversal: Ensures malicious payloads are dropped before touching cache or backends.

steps.title: Cache Hit Return
steps.action: Cloud CDN retrieves cached asset from RAM and streams HTTP 200 to client.
steps.why_traversal: Total response time is 12ms; origin backend VM is never contacted.

scenarios.label: Cache Stampede / Origin Overload
scenarios.root_cause: Cache expired during viral traffic surge; 50,000 concurrent requests bypassed CDN to origin.
scenarios.diverted_path: Origin VM CPU saturates to 100%; request latency spikes to 4,000ms.
scenarios.blast_radius: Dynamic API calls queued behind static image processing.
scenarios.recovery: Enable Cloud CDN request collapsing and serve-stale-while-revalidating settings.

scenarios.label: Quota exhausted
scenarios.root_cause: A project or regional quota reaches its allocation limit.
scenarios.diverted_path: Requests surface elevated latency, errors, or denied actions.
scenarios.blast_radius: Consumers of the affected resource or dependency.
scenarios.recovery: Reduce load, restore the dependency, and add a tested prevention.

scenarios.label: Dependency unavailable
scenarios.root_cause: A required API or downstream dependency is unavailable.
scenarios.diverted_path: Requests surface elevated latency, errors, or denied actions.
scenarios.blast_radius: Consumers of the affected resource or dependency.
scenarios.recovery: Reduce load, restore the dependency, and add a tested prevention.

summary: Traces an external HTTPS request: from edge Anycast IP through Cloud Armor security evaluation and Cloud CDN cache check to backend Compute Engine VM.
